Rose Petal Powder Price Per Kg for Bulk Buyers

Rose petal powder is made from dried rose petals ground into a fine, fragrant powder. Cosmetic formulators, tea blenders and food manufacturers buy it for its soft pink colour and floral aroma. If you are comparing rose petal powder price per kg offers, Tradenest Naturals supplies natural rose petal powder wholesale from Surat, India. As a bulk rose petal powder supplier, we focus on steady colour, aroma and particle size from batch to batch. We start with carefully selected petals from trusted growers. The petals are dehydrated and milled into a fine powder that keeps much of the natural floral scent and colour. Buyers who have worked with other rose petal powder suppliers often tell us that consistency is what they care about most. That is where we put our effort.

Processing and Quality

Each lot of raw petals is cleaned and sorted by hand to remove stems and foreign matter. Next, the petals are dehydrated at controlled temperatures. Then we mill the dried material and sieve it to 80-100 mesh for a smooth, even texture. Our facility works to hygienic handling practices throughout. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. This keeps our natural rose petal powder wholesale supply transparent and easy to approve for your own compliance team.

Key Product Specifications

  • Botanical Name: Rosa centifolia / Rosa damascena
  • Mesh Size: 80-100 mesh
  • Moisture Content: < 8%
  • Processing: Dehydrated
  • Appearance: Fine pinkish-red powder
  • Flavor Profile: Sweet, floral and aromatic

Applications in Cosmetics and Food

Rose petal powder works across several product categories. Cosmetic brands use it in face masks, scrubs, bath products and handmade soaps. Herbal product makers add it to botanical blends. Food and beverage companies use it to flavour and colour teas, desserts and confectionery. As a rose petal powder exporter, we ship to buyers in North America, the UK and Europe. We offer flexible packaging, export documentation support, and OEM and private label packing for your brand.

Why Choose Tradenest Naturals?

Working with a dependable rose petal powder supplier India makes planning easier. We offer fair pricing, a low 5 Kg minimum order and clear answers to technical questions. We value long-term B2B relationships built on honest communication.
